_readme: 'Around Boston' digest on the home page (design-explorations/README.md, option F). Takeaways are in our own words, never copied. The home page shows the first 5. Check each URL still loads before publishing. Last checked 2026-11-18.

items.title: Household Employer's Tax Guide (Pub. 926), 2026
items.takeaway: Pay one household employee $3,000+ this year and Social Security and Medicare apply to all of it.

items.title: Domestic workers: notice of rights and model agreement
items.takeaway: Working 16+ hours a week? Massachusetts requires a written agreement, and the AG gives you a free template.

items.title: Paid Family & Medical Leave rates and calculator
items.takeaway: A one-nanny household remits 0.46% of wages for paid leave, with no employer share.

items.title: Child Care in America: 2025 Price & Supply
items.takeaway: Massachusetts has the priciest infant center care of any state that reported: about $27,000 a year in 2025. Download the Massachusetts fact sheet.

items.title: 2026 Cost of Care Report
items.takeaway: National posted nanny rates averaged about $870 a week. Boston runs higher, and the report on how parents are coping is worth a read.
